blocks.title: Compare equivalent totals
blocks.instructions: Recognize that 3/6 and 1/2 name the same amount and explain why.

blocks.title: Compare two valid methods
blocks.instructions: Teacher models unlike-denominator addition with two common denominators and checks the total against the addends and one whole.

blocks.title: Ordinary paired strategy practice
blocks.instructions: All pairs solve two new fraction-addition calculations, compare methods, and justify whether each answer is reasonable.

blocks.title: Apply and explain
blocks.instructions: Students solve fresh fraction-addition word problems and explain one method to a partner while the teacher circulates.

blocks.title: Independent explanation
blocks.instructions: Students complete a fresh sum and explain how they know the answer is reasonable.
